summary: Sanction for prosecution under Section 197 CrPC; deemed sanction due to delay; BIS refused sanction, found no involvement; High Court denied quashing, granted bail; SC examines validity of cognizance without express sanction; proceedings initiated based on deemed sanction; challenge to maintainability of prosecution of public servant; accused not named in FIR or initial statements; allegations emerged in Section 164 CrPC statement; accused filed counter affidavit in official capacity; complainant alleged lack of authorization and threats; cognizance taken by Magistrate; High Court upheld proceedings, reserved bail; question of law: whether prosecution valid in absence of formal sanction after deemed period; argument on strict compliance with time limit for sanction.
legal_provisions_cited: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
Vineet Narain vs. Union of India, AIR 1998 SC 889
